customer_id.meaning: primary id of the member-services customer profile (seed uuid or content hash); one profile per natural person, shared by every membership, card, order and service record that person owns

name.meaning: the customer's full legal name exactly as it appears on the government photo ID shown at membership sign-up

phone_number.meaning: the mobile or home phone number registered on the profile; the number used to look a member up at the membership counter

email.meaning: the email address registered on the profile, lower case, as used for receipts, renewal notices and reward certificates

date_of_birth.meaning: the customer's date of birth as captured from the photo ID at sign-up

postal_code.meaning: the ZIP code of the customer's residential address on file

profile_opened_date.meaning: the date the customer profile was first created at Northgate (the earliest membership sign-up), never changed afterwards

membership_id.meaning: primary id of one membership account (one membership number, one tier at a time)

customer_id.meaning: the primary member who owns the membership (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the membership tier currently held, written as the official full tier name; changes only through an upgrade or downgrade event

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the membership (basis defined in the membership charter lifecycle.states)

member_number.meaning: the membership number printed on every card of this membership; it never changes across renewals, upgrades or downgrades

business_name.meaning: the registered business name on a Business or Business Plus membership exactly as on the business license; empty string for consumer tiers

opened_date.meaning: the date the membership was first purchased (the first term start); never changes

term_start_date.meaning: the first day of the current paid membership year

expiry_date.meaning: the last day of the current paid membership year (the renewal date); the membership is usable through the end of this date

auto_renew.meaning: whether automatic renewal is switched on for this membership

auto_renew_tender.meaning: the payment method on file that the automatic renewal charge is billed to; none when auto_renew is false

eligibility_verified_through.meaning: for Student Club and Heroes Club memberships, the last date through which the student or service status verification is valid; empty string for tiers that need no verification

annual_reward_balance.meaning: Annual Reward accrued in the current membership year and not yet converted to a certificate; identically the sum of the annual_reward account deltas

closed_date.meaning: the date the membership was cancelled or closed; empty string while it is not cancelled or closed

membership_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one membership ledger entry; for an Annual Reward certificate this id is also the certificate reference

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the membership charter

transaction_date.meaning: the business date the entry was posted

amount.meaning: the magnitude of the entry; whether it adds to or subtracts from its account is fixed by the event family's direction, never by a sign

fee_type.meaning: which membership fee a fee charge or fee refund relates to; not_applicable for reward entries

term_start_date.meaning: the first day of the membership year the fee pays for or the reward belongs to; empty string when not applicable

term_end_date.meaning: the last day of the membership year the fee pays for or the reward belongs to (the reward year end for certificates); empty string when not applicable

membership_card_id.meaning: for an add-on card fee or its refund, the add-on card issuance the fee is for (foreign key -> membership_cards); empty string otherwise

tender.meaning: how a fee was paid, or the tender a refund is returned to; not_applicable for reward entries

refund_reason.meaning: why a fee refund was issued; not_applicable for every other entry

source_txn_id.meaning: for a refund, the fee charge being refunded; for a certificate reissue, the original certificate issuance; empty string otherwise (foreign key -> membership_transactions)

source_category.meaning: for Annual Reward accruals and reversals, which business line the qualifying purchase or refund came from; not_applicable otherwise

source_ref_id.meaning: for Annual Reward accruals and reversals, the id of the exact order line (order_lines.order_line_id) or optical ledger entry (optical_transactions.optical_txn_id) that earned or reversed the reward; empty string otherwise

basis_amount.meaning: for Annual Reward accruals and reversals, the pre-tax qualifying purchase or refund amount the reward was computed on; 0.00 on every other entry

membership_card_id.meaning: primary id of one card issuance or card deactivation entry on a membership

customer_id.meaning: the primary member who owns the membership (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the membership charter

card_type.meaning: which card on the membership the entry concerns: the primary member's card, the free household card, or a paid business add-on card

cardholder_name.meaning: the name printed on the card, exactly as on the cardholder's photo ID

event_date.meaning: the date the card was issued or deactivated

issue_reason.meaning: why a card was issued; not_applicable on deactivation entries

deactivation_reason.meaning: why a card was deactivated; not_applicable on issuance entries

source_card_id.meaning: for a deactivation or a replacement issuance, the card issuance being deactivated or replaced (foreign key -> membership_cards); empty string otherwise

membership_request_id.meaning: primary id of one membership change request taken by member services

customer_id.meaning: the primary member who made the request (foreign key -> customers)

membership_id.meaning: the membership the request is about (foreign key -> membership_holdings)

status.meaning: submitted when member services records it, confirmed once the primary member confirms it, withdrawn if the member retracts it before confirming

requested_date.meaning: the date the member asked for the change; anchors refund proration and window checks

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: the moment the request was recorded

card_account_id.meaning: primary id of one co-branded or store credit card account

customer_id.meaning: the primary cardholder (foreign key -> customers)

variant_name.meaning: the card product held, written as the official full product name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the card account (basis defined in the card charter lifecycle.states)

linked_membership_id.meaning: the Northgate membership the card is linked to; a card can only be held while linked to a membership of the cardholder (foreign key -> membership_holdings)

card_last4.format: 4 digits, or empty string until approved
card_last4.meaning: the last four digits of the card number; empty string while the application is pending or after a decline

credit_limit.meaning: the credit line assigned by the issuing bank at approval

opened_date.meaning: the date the application was submitted

rewards_balance.meaning: card rewards earned in the current reward year and not yet converted to a certificate; identically the sum of the card_rewards account deltas

closed_date.meaning: the date the account was closed or declined; empty string otherwise

card_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one card rewards ledger entry; for a reward certificate this id is also the certificate reference

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the card charter

transaction_date.meaning: the date the entry was posted (for statement earnings, the statement closing date)

statement_period.meaning: the billing statement month the earning or reversal belongs to; the reward-year end month for certificates and forfeitures

spend_category.meaning: the earning category of an earning or reversal entry; all_categories for certificates and forfeitures

qualifying_spend.meaning: net qualifying purchases in that statement period and category that the reward was computed on; 0.00 for certificates and forfeitures

amount.meaning: the reward amount of the entry; its effect on the card_rewards account is fixed by the event family's direction

reward_year.meaning: the calendar reward year (January through December statements) the entry belongs to

source_txn_id.meaning: for a certificate reissue, the original certificate issuance; empty string otherwise (foreign key -> card_transactions)

order_id.meaning: primary id of one purchase transaction (one receipt or one online order)

customer_id.meaning: the member who made the purchase (foreign key -> customers)

membership_id.meaning: the membership whose card was presented for the purchase (foreign key -> membership_holdings)

variant_name.meaning: the purchase channel of the transaction, written as the official channel name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the purchase (basis defined in the order charter lifecycle.states)

receipt_number.format: 20 digits: 4-digit club number + 2-digit register + 4-digit transaction + YYYYMMDD + 2-digit check
receipt_number.meaning: the receipt or order number printed on the receipt or order confirmation

club_number.meaning: the Northgate club (warehouse) where the purchase was rung up or the order is fulfilled from

order_date.meaning: the date the purchase was rung up or the online order was placed

fulfilled_date.meaning: the date the member received the merchandise (register date in club, pickup date, or carrier delivery date); empty string until fulfilled

tender.meaning: the primary tender used to pay for the purchase; refunds go back to it unless a policy says otherwise

net_paid_amount.meaning: merchandise paid net of returns, price adjustments and rebates; identically the sum of the net_paid account deltas

closed_date.meaning: the date the purchase was cancelled or fully returned; empty string otherwise

order_line_id.meaning: primary id of one line-level ledger entry (a sale, a return, a price adjustment or a rebate credit)

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the order charter

item_number.format: 6 or 7 digits, or empty string on fee entries
item_number.meaning: the Northgate item number printed on the receipt; empty string on fee and fee-refund entries

item_description.meaning: the item description exactly as printed on the receipt; empty string on fee and fee-refund entries

merchandise_class.meaning: the merchandise class that drives return windows, price adjustment and reward eligibility; not_applicable on fee and fee-refund entries

quantity.meaning: units sold, returned, adjusted or rebated on this entry

unit_price.meaning: the per-unit price on a sale; the per-unit credit on a return, adjustment or rebate

line_amount.meaning: quantity x unit_price; its effect on net_paid is fixed by the event family's direction

event_date.meaning: the date the sale, return, adjustment or rebate was posted

source_order_line_id.meaning: for a return, price adjustment or rebate credit, the exact sale line it is against (foreign key -> order_lines); empty string on sale lines

return_reason.meaning: why a line was returned or refunded (order_cancelled for refunds of a cancelled order); not_applicable on other entries

adjustment_type.meaning: the kind of post-purchase credit on an adjustment or rebate entry; not_applicable on sales and returns

fee_type.meaning: which order-level fee a fee entry or fee refund concerns; not_applicable on merchandise entries

item_price_id.meaning: for a price adjustment or rebate credit, the price or promotion record the credit was computed from (foreign key -> item_price_history); empty string otherwise

reward_eligible.meaning: set at sale (and copied to entries against that sale): true when the membership presented was a Plus tier and the merchandise class earns Annual Reward

return_authorization_id.meaning: primary id of one return authorization for merchandise the member wants to send back without visiting a club

customer_id.meaning: the member returning the merchandise (foreign key -> customers)

order_id.meaning: the purchase the merchandise came from (foreign key -> order_holdings)

order_line_id.meaning: the exact sale line being returned (foreign key -> order_lines)

quantity.meaning: units of the sale line covered by the authorization

return_method.meaning: how the merchandise travels back to Northgate

status.meaning: submitted when member services opens it, confirmed once the member confirms the pickup or label, received when the returns center logs the item, withdrawn if the member retracts it

requested_date.meaning: the date the member asked to return the item; the return-window check is made against this date

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: the moment the authorization was recorded

item_price_id.meaning: primary id of one price or promotion period for one item on one purchase channel

item_number.meaning: the Northgate item number the price applies to

channel.meaning: the purchase channel the price is offered on, written as the official channel name

price_type.meaning: regular member price, an Instant Savings promotion price, a clearance price, or a manufacturer mail-in rebate offer

unit_price.meaning: the member price per unit in effect during the period; for mail_in_rebate, the rebate amount paid per unit

start_date.meaning: the first day the price or offer is in effect

end_date.meaning: the last day the price or offer is in effect; empty string while open-ended

member_limit.meaning: maximum units per membership the promotion or rebate applies to; 0 = no limit

claim_deadline.meaning: for mail_in_rebate offers, the last day a rebate claim is accepted; empty string for other price types

delivery_id.meaning: primary id of one delivery (and installation) appointment for big and bulky merchandise

customer_id.meaning: the member receiving the delivery (foreign key -> customers)

order_id.meaning: the purchase whose merchandise is being delivered (foreign key -> order_holdings)

variant_name.meaning: the delivery service level booked, written as the official service name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the appointment (basis defined in the delivery charter lifecycle.states)

delivery_window.meaning: the currently booked arrival window, local time at the delivery address

delivery_postal_code.meaning: the ZIP code of the delivery address

distance_miles.meaning: road distance from the delivering club or cross-dock to the delivery address, as computed at booking

booked_date.meaning: the date the appointment was first booked

reschedule_count.meaning: how many times the member has moved this appointment

attempt_count.meaning: how many times a crew has gone out for this appointment, successful or not

crew_arrival_time.format: HH:MM 24-hour local time, or empty string
crew_arrival_time.meaning: the time the crew arrived at the address on the most recent attempt, as logged by the crew's handheld; empty string before the first attempt

attempt_failure_reason.meaning: why the most recent attempt failed, as logged by the crew; not_applicable while no attempt has failed

completed_date.meaning: the date the crew completed delivery (and installation); empty string until completed

closed_date.meaning: the date the appointment was cancelled; empty string otherwise

delivery_charge_id.meaning: primary id of one delivery fee or delivery credit entry

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the delivery charter

charge_type.meaning: the fee component a charge is for, or that a credit returns

amount.meaning: the fee or credit amount; its effect on delivery_fees is fixed by the event family's direction

event_date.meaning: the date the charge or credit was posted

service_date.meaning: the appointment date the fee relates to (the new date for a reschedule fee, the failed date for a redelivery fee)

units.meaning: billing units: items hauled away, flights of stairs, miles beyond the included radius, or 1 for flat fees

credit_reason.meaning: why a credit was issued; not_applicable on charges

source_charge_id.meaning: for a credit, the exact charge being credited back (foreign key -> delivery_charges); empty string on charges

delivery_claim_id.meaning: primary id of one post-delivery claim

customer_id.meaning: the member making the claim (foreign key -> customers)

delivery_id.meaning: the completed appointment the claim is about (foreign key -> delivery_holdings)

claim_type.meaning: what the member reports went wrong

status.meaning: submitted when recorded, confirmed once the member attests to the claim, approved or denied by the delivery claims desk, withdrawn if retracted

reported_date.meaning: the date the member reported the problem; the claim-window check is made against this date

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
created_at.meaning: the moment the claim was recorded

tire_service_id.meaning: primary id of one Tire Center installation package on one set of tires on one vehicle

customer_id.meaning: the member who bought the installation (foreign key -> customers)

order_id.meaning: the purchase on which the tires were bought (foreign key -> order_holdings)

values: Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package
Northgate Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard
Northgate Light Truck Tire Installation Package with Road Hazard
variant_name.meaning: the installation package purchased, written as the official package name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the package (basis defined in the tire charter lifecycle.states)

vehicle_description.meaning: year, make, model and trim of the vehicle exactly as entered on the Tire Center work order

tire_size.format: tire size designation, e.g. 225/65R17 or LT265/70R17
tire_size.meaning: the size of the tires installed

tire_item_number.meaning: the Northgate item number of the tire model installed, as on the purchase's sale line

tire_unit_price.meaning: the price paid per tire on the purchase, after any Instant Savings at the register; the base of every pro-rata credit

tire_count.meaning: number of tires covered by the package

treadwear_warranty_miles.meaning: the manufacturer's treadwear mileage warranty printed for the tire model; 0 when the model carries none

install_date.meaning: the date the tires were mounted on the vehicle; empty string until installed

install_odometer.meaning: vehicle odometer reading recorded on the work order at installation

closed_date.meaning: the date the package was cancelled or retired; empty string otherwise

tire_event_id.meaning: primary id of one Tire Center service, charge or credit entry

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the tire charter

service_date.meaning: the date the service was performed or the charge or credit posted

odometer_miles.meaning: vehicle odometer reading on the work order for this visit (the install odometer for installation charges)

tire_position.meaning: the wheel position serviced; all_positions for whole-set work and set-level charges

charge_component.meaning: what a charge bills or a credit returns; not_applicable on service-only entries

amount.meaning: the charge, credit or replacement value of the entry; 0.00 on no-charge services; its account effect is fixed by the event family's direction

remaining_tread_32nds.meaning: tread depth measured at the shallowest groove of the tire concerned on this visit; 0 when not measured

damage_cause.meaning: the road damage found on a flat repair or road hazard visit; not_applicable otherwise

source_event_id.meaning: for a credit, or for a charge that follows a road hazard or treadwear determination, the entry it is against (foreign key -> tire_services); empty string otherwise

optical_order_id.meaning: primary id of one prescription eyewear job (one pair of glasses)

customer_id.meaning: the member the eyewear is for, or the member who placed it for a household dependent (foreign key -> customers)

membership_id.meaning: the membership presented when the job was ordered (foreign key -> membership_holdings)

variant_name.meaning: the lens design ordered, written as the official lens product name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the eyewear job (basis defined in the optical charter lifecycle.states)

rx_issue_date.meaning: the date the eyeglass prescription used for the job was written by the prescribing doctor

frame_description.meaning: brand, model, color and size of the frame exactly as on the optical work order

vision_plan.meaning: the vision insurance plan billed for the job; none for private pay

order_date.meaning: the date the job was ordered at the optical counter

dispensed_date.meaning: the date the finished eyewear was first fitted and handed to the patient; empty string until dispensed

remake_count.meaning: how many remakes have been opened on this job

closed_date.meaning: the date the job was cancelled or returned; empty string otherwise

optical_txn_id.meaning: primary id of one optical charge or credit entry

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the optical charter

event_date.meaning: the date the entry was posted

charge_component.meaning: the component a charge bills or a credit returns or offsets

amount.meaning: the charge or credit amount; positive on every entry except a remake_charge entry, which is 0.00 when a guarantee covers the remake; its effect on optical_balance is fixed by the event family's direction

remake_number.meaning: 0 for entries on the original job, n for entries on the n-th remake

remake_reason.meaning: why the remake an entry belongs to was opened; not_applicable for remake_number 0

credit_reason.meaning: why a credit was posted; not_applicable on charges

source_txn_id.meaning: for a refund credit, the exact charge being refunded (foreign key -> optical_transactions); empty string otherwise

reward_eligible.meaning: true when the membership on the job was a Plus tier at the time of the charge and the component earns Annual Reward; copied onto refunds of that charge

protection_plan_id.meaning: primary id of one Northgate Care protection plan contract

customer_id.meaning: the plan holder (foreign key -> customers)

order_line_id.meaning: the sale line of the covered product (foreign key -> order_lines)

values: Northgate Care 3-Year Electronics Plan with Accident Protection
variant_name.meaning: the protection plan purchased, written as the official plan name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the plan (basis defined in the protection charter lifecycle.states)

covered_product_price.meaning: the price paid for the covered product on its sale line; the plan's limit of liability

purchase_date.meaning: the date the plan was bought

coverage_start_date.meaning: the first day the plan covers failures

coverage_end_date.meaning: the last day the plan covers failures

closed_date.meaning: the date the plan was cancelled or fulfilled; empty string otherwise

protection_event_id.meaning: primary id of one plan charge, refund, claim or settlement entry; for a claim this id is the claim reference

customer_id.meaning: owning customer (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event-family type, taken verbatim from the event types declared in the protection charter

event_date.meaning: the date the entry was posted (for a claim, the date the failure was reported)

failure_date.meaning: for a claim or settlement, the date the product failed as stated on the claim; empty string on charges and refunds

failure_type.meaning: the failure reported on a claim and its settlement; not_applicable on charges and refunds

claim_outcome.meaning: how a claim was settled; not_applicable on charges, refunds and unsettled claims

amount.meaning: the plan charge, refund or settlement value; 0.00 on a claim filing and on a denial

source_event_id.meaning: for a settlement, the claim it settles; for a refund, the plan charge refunded (foreign key -> protection_events); empty string otherwise

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the identity-verification record (one per customer)

customer_id.meaning: the customer being verified (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether verification passed (monotonically non-decreasing within a call)

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: the moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the human-handoff record

customer_id.meaning: the customer handed off (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: the reason for the handoff; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
